name: io.github.devops-infinity/ownpg
title: OwnPG
description: PostgreSQL DBA tools over MCP, scoped to one database and one schema, with read, write, DDL, role, maintenance, monitoring, and host program tools.

packageArguments.name: --mode
packageArguments.description: Access mode: read-only, write-only, or read-write.

packageArguments.name: --database
packageArguments.description: The one database this server manages.

packageArguments.name: --schema
packageArguments.description: The one schema this server manages.

environmentVariables.name: OWNPG_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host name, address, or Unix socket directory.

environmentVariables.name: OWNPG_USER
environmentVariables.description: The PostgreSQL role to connect as.
